provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2025 NCAA Division I men's and women's soccer tournaments as played: every game's pairing, home side, score after overtime, shoot-out and kickoff from ESPN's daily scoreboards, with seeds from ESPN, cross-checked against Wikipedia's tournament pages. The men's field is 48, its 16 national seeds starting in the second round, named on the home side of their game; the women's is 64, four brackets of eight seeds each, named for their 1 seed as Wikipedia names them. Unseeded teams share the seed after the last (17 for the men, 9 for the women), so an upset bonus counts against them. Rounds before the College Cup are hosted by the higher seed (or the home side ESPN lists); the semifinals and final are neutral (WakeMed Soccer Park for the men, CPKC Stadium for the women). Half-time scores are left out: the pages' goal lists do not give them reliably. Rankings are seed order, then name. Odds to win are made up by ranking.
